title: pipeline_acceptance
description: Pipeline acceptance (promotion) record — emitted by lib/pipeline_synthesizer.py::accept_synthesis when a staged pipeline is promoted to pipeline_defs/. Separate from pipeline_synthesis (which captures the pre-approval synthesis event) so neither schema carries fields that don't apply to the event it describes (CLEAN-09 / v2.0 Phase 5 REVIEW MR-02).

promoted_slug.description: Slug that was promoted — filename stem (no .yaml extension) now living under pipeline_defs/.

promoted_path.description: Repo-relative path to the promoted YAML file under pipeline_defs/<slug>.yaml (never under _staging/ — the whole point of promotion).

validation_status.description: Semantic validation result against the PROMOTED manifest (every skill: path exists, every tools_available entry is registered). 'pending' is not a valid value here — promotion is synchronous.

validation_issues.description: When validation_status=invalid, the human-readable issue list from validate_synthesized_pipeline. Empty or absent when status=valid.
